correctness.rationale: The 70 objects equal 60 labelled 6-cycles plus 10 disjoint triangle pairs. Every edge lies in 28 factors, so a multilinear expansion proves W(s)=2 mod4 for every one of the 32768 characters. A concrete 3-edge witness has W=-2, proving the sharp Hilbert inverse gap. The embedded checker enumerates by independent mask and cycle-decomposition routes, confirms all 32768 signed direct sums against the integer FWHT, verifies the full eight-level multiplier census and Parseval, and exactly computes the inverse kernel by a second FWHT, a 512-character quotient calculation, and convolution identity at all 32768 points. Kernel histogram gives the exact rational 3691/770. No unproved asymptotic claim.

value.rationale: This is the first order at which a simple labelled 2-factor need not be connected: K6 simultaneously contains Hamiltonian cycles and disjoint triangle pairs. At K5 the single-edge character already cancels, while at K6 all 32768 signed coefficients survive despite 70 being even. More than an unsigned census, the result gives a six-valued sparse inverse kernel and exact sharp worst-case l1/linf recovery amplification 3691/770, needed to quantify stable signed 2-factor deconvolution; the result is not a mere normalization test.
